productRules.rule: Advisor and Attest roles are granted only through assignment to an accepted ServiceEngagement and never as a standing organization-wide grant.
A firm ServiceEngagement and a client AuditEngagement are different records; references must name the kind and tenant and neither implies the other's authorization.
No person may hold both an Advisor and an Attest assignment for the same client organization, at the same time or ever; the check covers the person's full assignment history for that client.
An impaired IndependenceEvaluation result blocks acceptance of the attest engagement with no override.

decides: Advisor and Attest access exists only through assignment to an accepted ServiceEngagement for that client, and no person may hold both an Advisor and an Attest assignment for the same client ever, checked over their full assignment history. An impaired evaluation blocks acceptance with no override, and a firm ServiceEngagement and a client AuditEngagement are distinct records, each reference naming its kind and tenant.
